system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m Geomorphon dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric landform classification tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only

band_semantics.b1: Geomorphon landform classification raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`. Values represent different landform types: 1=flat, 2=summit, 3=ridge, 4=shoulder, 5=spur, 6=slope, 7=hollow, 8=footslope, 9=valley, 10=depression.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection is organized as spatial Geomorphon tiles, not as a dated time series.
analytical_capabilities: Ecological niche modeling based on landform

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
